name: Tinker
ability: You might die at any time.
drunk_or_poisoned: A drunk or poisoned Tinker cannot die from its ability.

rulings.text: Day deaths are announced immediately; night deaths are marked with Dead and announced at dawn without a cause.
Protection from death (e.g. Tea Lady, Innkeeper) stops the Tinker dying from its ability.
The Storyteller should avoid killing the Tinker when it would end the game, and may choose never to kill it.

test_scenarios.name: Night death
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Tinker, Bob Imp, Dave Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Bob kills Dave; Storyteller also kills Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: At dawn Alice and Dave are announced dead, no cause.

test_scenarios.name: Protected
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Tinker protected by a Tea Lady.

test_scenarios.name: Day death
test_scenarios.actions: Storyteller kills Alice during the day.
